about: The postcommunio of the formulary “9th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the partaking of Your sacrament, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us and unite us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
